excluded_from_performance_samples: An initial Docker rebuild ran out of disk before timing began; only four explicitly identified task-owned nonshared cache records were removed, and the source-matched immutable image was reused.
Initial host regression failures involved shared /tmp and root-owned generated Python caches; read-only Docker mounts and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE removed this interference.
A Docker regression run lacked an account entry for UID 1000; after adding the account, both final output partitions passed.
The first native GitHub workflow omitted the real scanner installation. Its readiness check correctly failed; the workflow now installs the existing pinned scanner and runs host contracts.
production_defects_fixed_separately: Old awk without interval regular expressions did not apply audit retention filename matching.
jq 1.6 contains("\u0000") incorrectly matched clean strings; index("\u0000") preserves the intended NUL-only treatment.
measurement_limitation: Rootless Docker did not enforce the requested per-container cgroup limits. Same-image paired timings are retained with the actual shared parent limits documented. Parent cgroup memory.peak is excluded from memory comparisons.
